title: Guy Hides “Pot” On Silver Platter In Plain Sight!
description:
On June 03rd, 2022, at 12:00 am, an officer in Oklahoma was on patrol when he observed a gold Cadillac where the male driver was not wearing a seatbelt. Upon confirming the seatbelt was not fastened, the officer activated his emergency lights and pulled the vehicle over.

The suspect was arrested and later charged with DUI - Under 21, Carrying a Weapon Under the Influence of Alcohol or Drugs, Obstruction of a Police Officer, and, 2 Counts of Possession of a Controlled Dangerous Substance.
